This satisfies the narrow-exact-invariant criterion (motivated object, unknown non-mechanical value, retrievable precise fact). Not a textbook restatement, not a mere parameter substitution of the disjoint (51,25,12) Hadamard template, not a tiny unmotivated gain, not an unexplained enumeration (every failure carries its spectrum). Limitations honestly stated; no general theorem or completed plane census demanded beyond the admitted claim.
